handoff: Review #3: changes requested, with 2 blocking findings. Review #2's F1–F4 are fixed. Unit 1079/0, typecheck clean. F1: norn status and story list hide a config error and exit 0, with no Config error title (B7). F2: migrate's note for a dropped team notifiers/trace repeats the old key, which the new norn refuses (B43). Minor: init half setup on an old user file, no modeline in the local file, migrate reflows workflows, blind casts, unvalidated legacyConfig, fallback drops whole keys.

findings.title: status hides a config error and exits 0
findings.detail:
With `max_agent: 4` in ~/.norn/config.yaml, `norn status` and `norn status --json` exit 0 and show no error (the view runs on the fallback config). `story list` prints only a `!` warning line. Spec B7: 'every config error shown under the title "Config error" with its own exit code … Example: any command that loads config with a typo in the local file → the "Config error" title, the config exit code; `--json` prints a `CliError` with code `config_invalid`'. Review #2 raised this as minor and it was left as-is; it breaks B7 for the main command a person reads.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Make status/story list refuse with configError (exit 6, CliError config_invalid in --json), or show the config error as an inbox item with the config exit code. Add an S1 test: typo in the local file → status exits 6 with code config_invalid.

findings.title: migrate advises pasting an old key the new norn refuses
findings.detail:
PERSONAL_NOTE echoes the old key and value. For team `notifiers: [{adapter: ntfy, options: {url: https://ntfy.sh/team}}]` the report says 'set it in ~/.norn/config.yaml if you want it: `notifiers: [...]`'. Pasting that into the user file gives config_moved (`notifiers` is now `notify`). `default_agent` is translated to `agent: codex`, but notifiers is not. Spec B43: 'list each one with its value, so that nobody's machine changes without them knowing'. Seen in a temp repo run of the dev build.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Translate the value to its new shape with the same mapping the user-file migration uses (`notify: {ntfy: https://ntfy.sh/team}`). Add a migrate S1 test for team notifiers.

findings.title: init fails on an old user file after writing half its setup
findings.detail:
With `default_mode: auto` in the user file, init writes the team file, schemas and workflows, and only then exits 6. That leaves no hooks and no .gitignore entry. Verified in a temp repo.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Load and check the config before init writes anything.

findings.title: local file created by `config set --local` has no schema modeline
findings.detail:
The local schema copy is written, but the local file created on first `config set --local` has no `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` line, so editors never pick up the schema.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Write the modeline when creating the local file.

findings.title: workflow rewrite reflows the whole file
findings.detail:
Migrating quick.yaml changed 93 lines for about 4 added: long strings are wrapped and flow maps exploded (the Plan's Risks names this).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Stringify with lineWidth: 0 and keep flow style.

findings.title: B47 S1 test asserts the string its fake throws
findings.detail:
The fake notifier throws the very '…fix it in ~/.norn/config.yaml' text the test then expects. The real check is wiring.test.ts:68.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Assert only the trace reject there, or build the notifier through wiring.

findings.title: config_wrong_file do_instead does not name the right file
findings.detail:
`config set --local max_agents 3` refuses with config_wrong_file, but 'Do instead' only says `norn config list`.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name the user file, or the command that sets the key there.

findings.title: blind casts of old team values
findings.detail:
`js(r.doc,["remote"]) as Record<…>`: a scalar `remote: origin` yields one removed entry per character. The same cast is used for `limits` (:168) and `default_mode` (:176).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Guard with isMap / typeof string.

findings.title: hand-checked raw team file and an unvalidated legacyConfig
findings.detail:
base_branch is read from the raw team file with typeof checks before resolveConfig. legacyConfig (schema config.ts:606) returns `c as ResolvedConfig` and nothing validates it (tick-trace.ts:256). AGENTS.md: never hand-roll checks of these shapes.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Take base_branch from the checked values; assertValid after legacyConfig.

findings.title: unreachable fallback in init
findings.detail:
ctx.ports() throws configError when the load fails, so `loaded.fallback` is never reached.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop the branch or build ports from the fallback.

findings.title: fallback drops a whole top-level key
findings.detail:
resolveConfig drops the whole top-level key of any problem, so one bad `agents.codex.model` loses every agents entry in that file. The B48 comment says 'failing keys'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Filter at leaf level or fix the comment.

findings.title: duplication and small smells
findings.detail:
File-source check duplicated (context.ts:172, agents-in-use.ts:15). `l.ok ? l : l.fallback` repeated three times. Workflow listing re-implemented in config-migrate.ts:218 (and it does not skip dotfiles). adapterError builds CliFailure(ExitCode.config) by hand next to configError. agents-in-use regex-parses entry keys. doctor.ts:233 comment says not cached, but it is cached per context. wiring buildPorts skips unknown notifier adapters silently. The doctor ports rebuild drops only the notifiers.
Axis: standards
